name: shi_sero
description: Shigella molecular serotype marker panel (ShigaTyper public-domain markers)
note: ShigaTyper 2.0.5 ShigellaRef5 marker panel, reformatted as gspec/v1; markers.json carries the O-antigen/POAC/virulence roles and serotype.json carries the first conservative marker-set resolver. The ipaH_c control is split into two non-overlapping presence fragments (1-640 and 641-780), a gspec-derived sensitivity marker for divergent ipaH alleles.

references.citation: Wu Y, Lau HK, Lee T, Lau DK, Payne J. In Silico Serotyping Based on Whole-Genome Sequencing Improves the Accuracy of Shigella Identification. Appl Environ Microbiol. 2019;85(7):e00165-19.
Senchenkova SN, Feng L, Yang J, et al. Structural and Genetic Characterization of the Shigella boydii Type 10 and Type 6 O Antigens. J Bacteriol. 2005;187(7):2551-2554.
references.note: wbaM is intact in type 10 and interrupted by IS629 in type 6; the 5' alignment start separates them.

caveats: Contig screens resolve S. boydii 6 vs 10 from the wbaM 5' alignment start; reads tables carry no alignment geometry and leave that pair unresolved.
The ipaH_c control is two non-overlapping presence fragments (1-640 and 641-780), not the full-length ShigaTyper gene: divergent ipaH alleles retain different parts of the gene.
ShigaPass GPL3 database content is deliberately not copied into this MIT bundle.
